captions.detailed: This 3D model features a mast-and-outrigger rotary head assembly mounted on a thick, circular black base. A central grey cylindrical mast rises from this base, supporting two independent collar blocks. The lower collar block extends to support a long orange arm, while the upper collar block supports a shorter blue arm. Both arms are designed to rotate independently around their respective vertical support pins on revolute joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a mast-and-outrigger rotary head assembly in CadQuery. It should feature a heavy circular black base with a central vertical grey mast. Mount two independent black collar blocks at different heights on the mast; the lower block should support a long orange outrigger arm, and the upper block should support a shorter blue outrigger arm, both rotatable on independent revolute joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base assembly using a thick cylinder for the foot and a taller, thinner cylinder for the central mast. It defines two collar blocks using combined boxes and cylinders with boreholes. Two unequal arm components (one long orange arm, one short blue arm) are modeled using a combination of cylinders for the pivot joints and extruded rounded boxes for the arm bodies. Finally, two revolute joints are defined to independently connect the orange and blue arms to their respective collar blocks on the mast.
